summary: Static technical audit against the expanded file (scripts/expand-md.js resolved the single {{prompt:what-packaging-is-1}} marker to its canonical fenced form) + four compendiums (platform_and_boundaries, research_claims, prompts, pedagogy technical subset). Live-verified 2026-07-10 via WebFetch/curl: all 8 cited URLs return 200; the hook-events list (SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit/PreToolUse/PostToolUse/Stop) matches code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks; the '1M context window' claim matches platform.claude.com's current Sonnet 5/Opus 4.8/Fable 5 spec table; the Klaassen TDD quote, the Huntley greenfield-only quote, and the Curran/Intercom percentages are verbatim-confirmed against primary sources. One non-blocking finding: body prose reads 'Sourcegraph's Amp (their coding-agent product, October 2025)' in a way that implies current ownership, but Amp spun off into an independent company in December 2025 (confirmed via Wikipedia/Sourcegraph's own announcement) — the underlying Oct-2025 quote and stance are still accurate, only the possessive framing has drifted. One related non-blocking finding: the 1M-context-window and Cherny/Claude-Code-creator facts are capability-adjacent claims with no dedicated line of their own in the Source-verification stamp block, per check_research_claims.md §11a's unified scope (a capability claim is a source needing the same stamp) — independently re-confirmed accurate this session but not recorded in-file. The sole registry prompt (curriculum/prompts/what-packaging-is-1.md) is mechanically clean: canonical shape, no placeholders, correct warm-session back-reference, three-move paragraph split, exact '**Prompt**' label, lead-in phrase mirrors the fence's opening clause. No skill references in the file. Full one-entry-per-rule ledger below per the completeness contract (47 platform_and_boundaries + 14 research_claims + 5 pedagogy technical-subset + 47 prompts = 113 rows). Supersedes the prior technical instance recorded in this file (2026-05-15, ~11-row ledger, predates the Ronacher-heading retitle, the Fix batch 2026-07-03, the slides-only pass 2026-07-02, and the emphasis pass 2026-07-09 — several of its citation quotes/line numbers no longer match current content).
